delivered.statement: Profit after tax INR330 crores in Q1 FY27
Total revenue INR1,370 crores, 18.10% YoY growth from INR1,160 crores
EBITDA INR386 crores with 28.17% margin despite 2.77% YoY decline
Catering INR732 crores, 33.82% YoY growth, 54% of total revenue
Rail Neer INR109 crores, 2.83% YoY growth with 10% margin
Tourism INR168 crores, 13.5% YoY growth, 11.31% EBITDA margin
Internet ticketing INR361 crores, 0.5% growth, 80% EBITDA margin
89% market share of reserved railway tickets booked via platform
E-catering revenue INR22 crores from INR16 crores, 1.69 lakh daily meals

themes: Diversified business model: catering 54%, ticketing 26%, tourism 12%, Rail Neer 8% of INR1,370cr revenue
Digital transformation: NGET platform upgrades, UI/UX redesign, e-catering expansion targeting 100 trains
Non-Fare Revenue opportunities: train naming rights (Sprite Tejas), vinyl wrapping driving premium margins
Rail Neer capacity expansion: new plants (Prayagraj, Mysore, Ranchi) to address 15.5 lakh bottle daily demand gap
Premium train proliferation: 20 Vande Bharat sleepers expand high-margin catering addressable market
Payment ecosystem: iPay pending RBI license to expand beyond 2.7 lakh daily transactions
risks: Rail Neer supply-demand gap: 17.77 lakh capacity vs 15.5 lakh daily demand filled by unauthorized vendors
Catering GST pressure: 5% no ITC benefit on prepaid trains reduces realization vs license fee trains
IT infrastructure investments: NGET modernization, disaster recovery, UI/UX transformation impacting margins near-term
One-time costs: INR20 crores HR/gratuity and INR4 crores Proof of Concept dragging Q1 margins, expected to ease
Commodity inflation: West Asia crisis increased Rail Neer resin/petroleum costs INR6 crores, compressed margins 15% to 11%
Convenience fee stagnation: 4.89% QoQ growth below inflation despite 8% passenger growth and policy constraint concerns

analyst_pushback.issue: Rail Neer supply constraints vs third-party brands availability
analyst_pushback.response: Expanding existing plants (Ambernath, Danapur) and launching 4 new plants targeting FY28 completion

analyst_pushback.issue: Catering quality perception and 25-30% passenger opt-out rate impacts demand
analyst_pushback.response: E-catering grown to 1.69 lakh daily meals; e-pantry on 50+ trains; exploring branded player partnerships

analyst_pushback.issue: Internet ticketing margin fell to 80% from historical 84-85%, dragging EBITDA
analyst_pushback.response: Temporary from NGET infrastructure upgrade (~INR150 crores), website transformation, disaster recovery investments

analyst_pushback.issue: Non-convenience fee collapsed from INR130-140 crores to INR113 crores, offsetting growth
analyst_pushback.response: Temporary from website redesign removing ads; iPay and e-wallet (200% growth) expected recovery to INR150 crores

tone_evidence: Confident on 18% growth and diversified model resilience, cautious on margin recovery timing and infrastructure investment payoff.
